subject.title: fix(cli): reject unknown models in config set

question: Should `openclaw config set` reject changed text-model references whenever the current configured provider catalog or selected auth profile cannot resolve them, instead of allowing the write and deferring failure to a later agent run?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically focused and proof-backed, but whether an existing operator’s configuration command should become fail-closed on catalog/auth resolution is a compatibility policy choice that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Approve fail-closed validation
options.body: Accept immediate rejection of unresolved changed text-model references so users receive a set-time error and the active config remains unchanged.

options.title: Retain deferred runtime validation
options.body: Keep current write behavior and pursue only diagnostics or an explicit opt-in validation mode if preserving existing operator workflows is more important.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed validation
recommendation.body: Accept immediate rejection of unresolved changed text-model references so users receive a set-time error and the active config remains unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Their member comment directly identifies the compatibility and provider/auth boundary as the remaining non-mechanical decision.
